---
title: "SC Frequencies"
output: html_document
date: "2025-10-22"
---

```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(xlsx)

# Load metadata
SCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)
serotypes <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/Serotypes.txt", header=T) |> mutate(GBS.SBG = ifelse(GBS.SBG=="", NA, GBS.SBG)) |>
  mutate(Serotype = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG,"\\*"),"\\?"))|>
  mutate(Serotype = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype), "III", Serotype))|>
  mutate(Serotype = factor(Serotype, levels=c("Ia", "Ib","II", "III", "IV", "V","VI","VII","VIII", "IX")))|>
  dplyr::select(-GBS.SBG)
CCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/combined_results_with_cc.txt") |> dplyr::select(Sample, clonal_complex)


# List samples from each dataset
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1) 
NL_samples <- NL_metadata |> filter(ENA.lane.accession %in% SCs$Sample) |> pull(ENA.lane.accession)
CDC_metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/phenotypes.txt", header=T) 
CDC_samples <- CDC_metadata |> filter(samples %in% SCs$Sample) |> pull(samples)

# Add country to metadata
metadata <- left_join(left_join(SCs, serotypes), CCs) |> 
  mutate(Country= ifelse(Sample %in% NL_samples, "NL", 
                         ifelse(Sample %in% CDC_samples, "USA", "TW")) )
TW_samples <- metadata |> filter(Country =="TW") |> pull(Sample) 

# Create a data frame for shading the region (independent of gene_pres_abs_clean_V2)
shade_data <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 0.7, by = 0.01))
shade_data <- shade_data %>%
  mutate(ymin_5 = pmax(0, x - 0.05),
         ymax_5 = pmin(0.6, x + 0.05),
         ymin_10 = pmax(0, x - 0.10),
         ymax_10 = pmin(0.6, x + 0.10),
         ymin_15 = pmax(0, x - 0.15),
         ymax_15 = pmin(0.6, x + 0.15),
         ymin_25 = pmax(0, x - 0.25),
         ymax_25 = pmin(0.6, x + 0.25))

# Data point colors
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd", 
                   "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf",
                   "#f7b6d2", "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94", "black")
names(SC_colors) <- c(1:14, "other")
```


# 1. Plot SC frequencies across countries
## 1.1. USA vs NL
```{r }
# Prepare Plot Data 
metadata_NL_USA <- metadata |>  filter(Country %in% c("USA", "NL"))
fewer5_SC_NL_USA <- names(which(table(metadata_NL_USA$SC)<10))
SC_Freq_df_NL_USA <- metadata_NL_USA |>
  group_by(Country)|>
  dplyr::mutate(N_Country = n())|>
  ungroup()|>
  group_by(Country, N_Country, SC)|>
  summarise(N_SC = n())|>
  ungroup()|>
  dplyr::mutate(p_SC = N_SC/N_Country)|>
  dplyr::select(Country, SC, p_SC)|>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Country, values_from = p_SC) |>
  rename(Proportion_NL=NL, 
         Proportion_CDC= USA) |>
  dplyr::mutate(SC= as.factor(SC), 
         Proportion_NL = ifelse(is.na(Proportion_NL), 0, Proportion_NL), 
         Proportion_CDC = ifelse(is.na(Proportion_CDC), 0, Proportion_CDC))|> 
  dplyr::mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC_NL_USA, "other", SC))|> 
  dplyr::mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:length(which(table(metadata$SC)>=10)), "other")))

# Correlation test 
cor_test_NL_USA <- cor.test(SC_Freq_df_NL_USA$Proportion_NL, SC_Freq_df_NL_USA$Proportion_CDC)
cor_coefficient_NL_USA <- round(cor_test_NL_USA$estimate, 2)
p_value_NL_USA <- signif(cor_test_NL_USA$p.value, 3)

# Plot
p_SC_NL_USA <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_5, ymax = ymax_5), fill = "grey95", alpha = 0.6)+
  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_25, ymax = ymax_25), fill = "grey95", alpha = 0.6)+
  geom_point(data= SC_Freq_df_NL_USA, aes(x = Proportion_NL, y = Proportion_CDC, color = SC2), size=3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +  
  theme_classic() +
  xlab(paste0("SC frequencies in Netherlands (n=", length(NL_samples), ")")) +
  ylab(paste0("SC frequencies in USA (n=", length(CDC_samples), ")")) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = 0.45, hjust = 0, label = paste("Pearson's correlation:\nr =", cor_coefficient_NL_USA, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_NL_USA< 0.001, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_NL_USA))), size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values=SC_colors)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.6), expand=c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.6), expand=c(0.02, 0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Infant Invasive Disease (n=", (length(NL_samples)+length(CDC_samples)), ")"))
p_SC_NL_USA

# Save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/2.SC_freq_correlations_USA_NL.png", plot = p_SC_NL_USA, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

# 2. Compare SC dsitribution across countries AND age cat
## 2.0. BarPlot SC in EOD vs LOD/VLOD across countries
```{r}
# Load phenotypes
phenotypes <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/phenotypes_filtered_clean.txt", header=T)|>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(binary==0, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD"))

metadata_phenotypes_df <- left_join(metadata, phenotypes)
fewer5_SC <- names(which(table(metadata_phenotypes_df$SC)<10))
metadata_phenotypes <- metadata_phenotypes_df |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|> 
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, levels= c(1:14, "other")))

# prepate stats for plot
metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_EOD <- metadata_phenotypes |> filter(Country %in% c("USA", "NL"), Age_cat =="EOD")
metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_LOD <- metadata_phenotypes |> filter(Country %in% c("USA", "NL"), Age_cat =="LOD/VLOD")
metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_EOD <- metadata_phenotypes |> filter(Country %in% c("USA", "TW"), Age_cat =="EOD")
metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_LOD <- metadata_phenotypes |> filter(Country %in% c("USA", "TW"), Age_cat =="LOD/VLOD")
metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_EOD <- metadata_phenotypes |> filter(Country %in% c("NL", "TW"), Age_cat =="EOD")
metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_LOD <- metadata_phenotypes |> filter(Country %in% c("NL", "TW"), Age_cat =="LOD/VLOD")

p_USA_NL_EOD    <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_EOD$SC, metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_EOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_USA_NL_LOD    <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_LOD$SC, metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_LOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_USA_TW_EOD    <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_EOD$SC, metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_EOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_USA_TW_LOD    <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_LOD$SC, metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_LOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_NL_TW_EOD     <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_EOD$SC, metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_EOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_NL_TW_LOD     <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_LOD$SC, metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_LOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value

# Format them for text display
format_p <- function(pval) {
  if (pval < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(pval, 2))
}

# Suppose we want annotations for Age_cat == "EOD":
bracket_df <- data.frame(
  Age_cat = c("EOD", "EOD", "EOD"),
  xstart = c(1, 1, 2),    # USA vs NL, USA vs TW, NL vs TW
  xend = c(2, 3, 3),
    y = c(1.05, 1.12, 1.19),
  label = c(format_p(p_USA_NL_EOD), format_p(p_USA_TW_EOD), format_p(p_NL_TW_EOD))
)

# Add for LOD/VLOD as well:
bracket_df <- bind_rows(
  bracket_df,
  data.frame(
    Age_cat = c("LOD/VLOD", "LOD/VLOD", "LOD/VLOD"),
    xstart = c(1, 1, 2),
    xend = c(2, 3, 3),
    y = c(1.05, 1.12, 1.19),
    label = c(format_p(p_USA_NL_LOD), format_p(p_USA_TW_LOD), format_p(p_NL_TW_LOD))
  )
)

# Summarize counts per Country and Age_cat:
bar_counts <- metadata_phenotypes %>%
  group_by(Country, Age_cat) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Factor levels for Country if needed (optional)
bar_counts$Country <- factor(bar_counts$Country, levels = c("USA", "NL", "TW"))

# Find the y-position for text above bars:
# Since you use "position = fill" (proportions), the top is always 1. We'll put label at 1.01.
bar_counts$ypos <- 1.01

# --- Your plot with geom_text for counts ---
barp_SC <- metadata_phenotypes %>%
  mutate(Country= factor(Country, levels= c("USA", "NL", "TW"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Country, fill=SC2)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_grid(Age_cat ~ .) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=SC_colors, name="SC") +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  theme_classic() +
  # Add bar counts:
  geom_text(
    data = bar_counts,
    aes(x = Country, y = ypos, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 0,     # so the label sits just above the bar
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  # [Keep your bracket and p-value code below, unchanged]
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_df,
    aes(x = xstart, xend = xend, y = y+ 0.02, yend = y+ 0.02, group=interaction(Age_cat, xstart, xend)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_df,
    aes(x = xstart, xend = xstart, y = y+ 0.02, yend = y+0.02),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_df,
    aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y+ 0.02, yend = y+0.02),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = bracket_df,
    aes(x = (xstart + xend)/2, y = y + 0.05, label = label),
    size = 3.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

barp_SC

# Save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/2.SC_Barplot_USA_NL_TW.png", plot = barp_SC, width = 6, height = 8, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

  scale_color_manual(values=SC_colors)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.6), expand=c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.6), expand=c(0.02, 0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Infant Invasive Disease (n=", (length(NL_samples_EOD)+length(CDC_samples_EOD)), ")"))
p_SC_NL_USA_EOD

# Save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/2.SC_freq_correlations_USA_NL_EOD.png", plot = p_SC_NL_USA_EOD, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")

# 3. Compare CC dsitribution across countries AND age cat
## 3.0. BarPlot CC in EOD vs LOD/VLOD across countries
```{r}
# Get association with country
p_USA_NL_EOD_CC   <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_EOD$clonal_complex, metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_EOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_USA_NL_LOD_CC    <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_LOD$clonal_complex, metadata_phenotypes_USA_NL_LOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_USA_TW_EOD_CC    <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_EOD$clonal_complex, metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_EOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_USA_TW_LOD_CC    <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_LOD$clonal_complex, metadata_phenotypes_USA_TW_LOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_NL_TW_EOD_CC     <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_EOD$clonal_complex, metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_EOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value
p_NL_TW_LOD_CC     <- chisq.test(metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_LOD$clonal_complex, metadata_phenotypes_NL_TW_LOD$Country, simulate.p.value = T, B=5000)$p.value

# Format them for text display
format_p <- function(pval) {
  if (pval < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(pval, 2))
}

# Suppose we want annotations for Age_cat == "EOD":
bracket_df_CC <- data.frame(
  Age_cat = c("EOD", "EOD", "EOD"),
  xstart = c(1, 1, 2),    # USA vs NL, USA vs TW, NL vs TW
  xend = c(2, 3, 3),
    y = c(1.05, 1.12, 1.19),
  label = c(format_p(p_USA_NL_EOD_CC), format_p(p_USA_TW_EOD_CC), format_p(p_NL_TW_EOD_CC))
)

# Add for LOD/VLOD as well:
bracket_df_CC <- bind_rows(
  bracket_df_CC,
  data.frame(
    Age_cat = c("LOD/VLOD", "LOD/VLOD", "LOD/VLOD"),
    xstart = c(1, 1, 2),
    xend = c(2, 3, 3),
    y = c(1.05, 1.12, 1.19),
    label = c(format_p(p_USA_NL_LOD_CC), format_p(p_USA_TW_LOD_CC), format_p(p_NL_TW_LOD_CC))
  )
)


# Main Plot
CC_colors <- carto.pal(pal1 = "pastel.pal" ,n1 = 13)
p_dist_CC <- metadata_phenotypes %>%
  mutate(Country= factor(Country, levels= c("USA", "NL", "TW"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Country, fill=clonal_complex)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_grid(Age_cat ~ .) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=CC_colors, name="CC") +
  theme_classic() +
  # Add brackets
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_df_CC,
    aes(x = xstart, xend = xend, y = y+ 0.02, yend = y+ 0.02, group=interaction(Age_cat, xstart, xend)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Left verticals
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_df_CC,
    aes(x = xstart, xend = xstart, y = y+ 0.02, yend = y+0.02),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Right verticals
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_df_CC,
    aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y+ 0.02, yend = y+0.02),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # P-value text
  geom_text(
    data = bracket_df_CC,
    aes(x = (xstart + xend)/2, y = y + 0.05, label = label),
    size = 3.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )+
  # Add bar counts:
  geom_text(
    data = bar_counts,
    aes(x = Country, y = ypos, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 0,     # so the label sits just above the bar
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12)))
p_dist_CC


# Save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/2.CC_Barplot_USA_NL_TW.png", plot = p_dist_CC, width = 6, height = 8, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
